title: In re Korean Southwest Orange County Presbytery
summary: As of March 3, 2022, Presbytery had not supplied formally adopted responses to records-review exceptions, although its clerk had prepared drafts. The SJC allowed time for adoption and filing by April 1, after which it would forward the responses for records review; failure to file would prompt a called hearing. This was an unfinished compliance process, not approval of the draft responses or a final merits decision.

sources.supported_claims: Supports the absence of adopted responses, clerk's drafts, April 1 deadline, conditional forwarding, and possible called hearing.
The full Minutes confirm the source-page boundary and the dated ongoing status.

source_limits: The March 3, 2022 record is an interim status. Repository case pages and later Minutes searched for this docket do not establish whether responses were later adopted, forwarded, or heard.
evidence_notes: A clerk's proposed responses were not Presbytery-adopted responses.
Forwarding was conditional on timely filing; it had not yet occurred in the reported decision.
The status is expressly dated to March 3, 2022 and should not be presented as current.

score_reasons.concrete_dispute: Identifies the response-compliance issue, though not the substance of the exceptions.
score_reasons.decision: Accurately reports the interim procedural directions.
score_reasons.decisive_reason: Explains that no formally adopted response had arrived.
score_reasons.fidelity: Dates the status and does not imply later events.
score_reasons.economy: Uses only details needed to understand the alternatives.

verification_notes: Separate source-checking pass by the same reviewer re-read the March 3 section and checked later repository Minutes for the docket; the final summary remains dated and does not convert planned actions into completed ones.
repair_notes: The canonical record reports body CJB, decision_year 1986, and assembly 14 despite the source's SJC decision dated March 3, 2022 in the 49th Assembly Minutes. It also omits 'In re' from the clean caption. These identity fields require reconciliation.
